trap-negation-contrast.evidence: table( pure-data block, 8 coefficient rows with S-eigenvalues. RECOMPUTED every row symbolically under the bar involution q->q^{-1} (sympy, ratio bar(e)/e): W_sym=W_alt=q^2/D -> ratio 1 (+1 correct); W_std=(q^2+1)^2/D -> 1 (+1 correct); [3]_q=q^2+1+q^{-2} -> 1 (+1 correct); h_A=q-q^{-1} -> -1 (-1 correct); h_A^2 -> +1 correct. INDEPENDENT INVARIANT: W_sym+W_std+W_alt = (q^2+(q^2+1)^2+q^2)/D = (q^4+4q^2+1)/D = 1 exactly, so D=q^4+4q^2+1 and all three weights are mutually confirmed; at q=1 they give 1/6, 4/6, 1/6 = dim_lambda^2/|S_3|, the correct Plancherel limit. Vol(B_3)=8G checked: G=Cl_2(pi/2)=0.915965594177, 8G=7.32772475342 -- this is the CORRECT value, not the live 8*Cl_2(pi/4)=7.85497720840 corpus error. alpha=m_e*8G=3.7445 MeV.
trap-negation-contrast.notes: TWO FINDINGS. (1) CONVENTION C, load-bearing. Row 'z = (q^{1/2}+q^{-1/2})^{-1}' is exactly convention C: it equals sqrt(q)/(q+1) = 0.499320334184 at the proton pin, against canonical convention D z=q^3/(q^2+1)=0.612688037146. The S-eigenvalue +1 assigned to it DEPENDS on C: bar(z_C)/z_C = 1, but bar(z_D)/z_D = q^{-4}, so under D this row is simply false. And z is not inert -- it appears inside Phi_1 = sum log|z a_i + b_i| in table1, so the parent's Phi_1 = +1 classification, hence its 'exactly one of the three terms is S-anti-invariant' conclusion, rests on it. Proposed fix: re-derive the parent under D, or scope the whole prop:frobenius-s-classification result as convention-C-conditional (per the 2026-08-15 R1 ruling). (2) D is only PROJECTIVELY S-invariant: bar(D)/D = q^{-4}, not 1, so the '+1' in the D row is true only in the 'palindromic' sense its own parenthetical states. Harmless because D occurs solely as the common denominator of the invariant ratios, but the column header claims more than the row delivers.
